depiction.primary_object: solid black eighth musical note inside a circle
depiction.composition: single glyph centered inside a circular ring

ambiguity: Closely resembles a beamed double musical note or the TikTok logo at a quick glance, though all share the core music meaning.

modifier_semantics.meaning: frames the note as a badge, button, or media symbol

task_intents: change phone ringtone or alert sound

reasoning: A single eighth note enclosed in a circle universally represents music, songs, playlists, and audio tracks. It fits many everyday tasks across hobbies, creative work, events, and music lessons, though tasks about specific hardware (headphones, microphones, instruments) are better served by icons of those objects.
